title: Priming wavefront scheduler and adaptive decode consolidation to reduce p99 tail and improve batching
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Performance: Introduce priming wavefront scheduler and adaptive decode consolidator to reduce p99 tail latency and improve sustained throughput. No API changes.
description: Summary: This PR adds a 'priming wavefront' scheduler to proactively prime KV cache and align continuous batching across GPU groups, plus an adaptive decode consolidator that merges short decode lanes opportunistically to improve kernel utilization. Motivation: We observed recurring p99 spikes for mixed short+long workloads where KV cache misses and small decode kernels caused underutilized kernels and scheduling noise. Instead of only reacting to misses, the scheduler now spreads lightweight priming across nearby GPU queues in a wavefront pattern and coordinates short-lifespan decodes into transient consolidated lanes.
context_and_motivation: Observed problems: (1) Short interactive requests frequently hit cold KV entries causing a sporadic 20-60ms tail; (2) Continuous batching left many small decodes on separate lanes causing kernel fragmentation and lower throughput under medium load; (3) Attempts to increase batching windows hurt latency SLO. Goal: reduce p99 and improve tokens/sec with minimal latency regression for median requests.
what_was_changed: Design changes: - Introduced WavefrontPrimingScheduler: tracks model kernel affinity groups, monitors recent KV access heatmaps, and issues low-priority priming tokens to warm KV in adjacent device queues. - Added PrimingManager: lightweight, idempotent KV warm RPC that prefers prefix-only priming and respects tenant soft deadlines. - AdaptiveDecodeConsolidator: tags short decodes (< config threshold) and co-schedules them into transient consolidated lanes based on a merge budget and deadline heuristics. - New metrics and tracing spans: priming.attempts, priming.hits, consolidator.merged_lanes, consolidator.latency_delta. - Tunables added to runtime config for priming depth, consolidation window, and merge budget.

files_diff_summary: Most changes are additive: new scheduler and consolidator modules, a small config file, test harness and observability wiring. No API surface changes to public inference endpoints. README and ops doc explain tuning knobs.
performance_results: Benchmark (internal perf-lab, p50/p95/p99 measured over synthetic mixed workload: 60% short (<=16 tokens), 30% medium, 10% long): Baseline: p50=18ms p95=42ms p99=128ms tokens/sec=1520 Cost/sample: baseline. Wavefront+Consolidator: p50=19ms p95=38ms p99=117ms tokens/sec=1734 Cost/sample: -6% Effective improvements: p99 reduced ~8.6% absolute, throughput +14%, cost per token down ~6% in throughput mode. Tail variance reduced significantly during stress tests with heterogeneous sequence length distributions.
safety_and_api_impact: No breaking API changes. Priming operations are tenant-aware and respect existing security/KMS boundaries. PrimingManager runs as low-priority work and will not preempt realtime decode kernels; all behavior is guarded by runtime flags and per-tenant budgets.
testing_and_ci: Unit tests: added coverage for PrimingManager idempotency and consolidator merge heuristics. Perf harness: added wavefront scenario. CI: initial run failed due to linter and a flaky test in test_priming_manager (race on clock mocking); fixes included making clock deterministic in test harness and a couple of style fixes. Final CI: all checks green (build, unit, integration-flaky, perf-smoke).
review_conversation: Connor Liu: Please add a metric indicating priming bytes issued per tenant; also request a guard so priming doesn't exceed tenant quota. Aisha: Added priming.bytes_issued and added quota guard (PrimingManager now honors tenant.quota.priming_tokens). Ravi Menon: Concerned about coalescing causing latency regression for single-stream decodes. Aisha: consolidator uses a soft deadline; single-stream decodes that hit deadline are flushed immediately. Added unit tests to validate deadline behavior. Elena Garcia: Suggested additional tracing context for correlating priming to eventual cache hits. Aisha: Added trace ids in PrimingManager and annotated the priming span with outcome. Approvals: Connor approved after metric + quota change; Ravi approved after deadline tests; Elena gave final thumbs up.
ci_log_summary: Initial CI run: lint failed (line length, missing header) and test_priming_manager flaky failure. After fixes and rebase onto main, CI run #2: all checks pass. Perf-flaky harness recorded baseline vs experiment traces attached to PR.
risk_and_rollout_plan: Feature gated behind runtime flag 'enable_wavefront_priming' and 'enable_adaptive_consolidator'. Default off for production. Rollout plan: 1) Enable in perf canary region for 24 hours with detailed SLO dashboards; 2) Enable for small subset of customers (5% traffic) and monitor priming.hits and consolidator.latency_delta; 3) Gradual ramp to 25/50/100% with rollback triggers if p99 increases by >5% or priming.bytes exceeds budget. Hotfix path: flags can be toggled at runtime via console; merges include metrics and alerting to expedite rollback.
followups_and_todo: - Tune priming depth heuristics based on live KV heatmaps (ENG-2187) - Extend consolidator policy to consider hardware topology and kernel packing heuristics - Add a tenant-level dry-run mode to surface priming suggestions in the console - Run a longer 7-day stability test in prod canary and collect traces for machine-learning based priming prediction.

notes_for_ops: Docs: docs/operational/priming-ops.md describes configuration knobs, dashboard panels to watch (priming.attempts, priming.hits, consolidator.merged_lanes, consolidator.latency_delta), and rollback steps. Default budgets are conservative. If enabled, watch for increased memory pressure on KV store and adjust priming depth.
internal_refs: Related work: ENG-2134 (wavefront priming POC), ENG-2139 (decode coalescing spec). Support ticket SUP-4412 included customer logs that motivated the design.
authors_notes: This change errs on the conservative side: priming uses prefix-only warmups and consolidator prefers to merge only very short decodes. We expect follow-ups to expand consolidation heuristics once metrics prove stability. Happy to pair with SRE to tune alerts and dashboards.
